max-file-size.description: The maximum file size in bytes

min-file-size.description: The minimum file size in bytes

allow-drop.description: Whether to allow drag and drop in the dropzone element

prevent-document-drop.description: Whether to prevent the drop event on the document

capture.description: The default camera to use when capturing media

directory.description: Whether to accept directories, only works in webkit browsers

disabled.description: Whether the file input is disabled

invalid.description: Whether the file input is invalid

required.description: Whether the file input is required

name.description: The name of the underlying file input

locale.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

filechange.description: Fired when the value changes, whether accepted or rejected

fileaccept.description: Fired when the file is accepted

filereject.description: Fired when the file is rejected

transformFiles.description: Function to transform the accepted files to apply transformations

ids.description: The ids of the elements. Useful for composition.

defaultAcceptedFiles.description:
The default accepted files when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the accepted files of the input.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

openFilePicker.description: Function to open the file dialog
